mapper.select: SELECT m.document_id FROM achievement_mains m WHERE m.is_delete = 0 AND m.document_id IS NOT NULL AND m.published_at IS NOT NULL AND m.achievement_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.id DESC

SELECT * FROM achievement_search_docs WHERE is_delete = 0 AND search_text IS NOT NULL AND search_text != '' AND (es_indexed_at IS NULL OR indexed_at IS NULL OR indexed_at > es_indexed_at) ORDER BY indexed_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
